definition.simple: A result measured in units of the amount you risked. 1R is the planned loss.
definition.balanced: R-multiple = profit or loss ÷ planned risk. A win of twice the risk is +2R. A full stop-out is −1R. Slippage can make a loss worse than −1R. Using R lets you compare trades of different sizes.

example: You risked 50 USD and made 75 USD. That trade was +1.5R.
